QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_37

question.text: When opening a new position, margins are first blocked from:

answer.text: Client collateral, then TM proprietary collateral, then CM collateral
A common pool maintained by the exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 183 says that for a client/TM trade the clearing corporation first blocks available collateral provided by the CM, and then releases CM collateral to the extent of the client/TM re-pledged securities available with the CC. The Trap: Client-level segregation and allocation rules describe how collateral is identified to clients/TMs; they do not change the fact that the first block at the CC for a new position is on CM-provided collateral. Note: Page 179 covers risk-reduction monitoring (collateral utilisation thresholds) rather than the first-block sequence used when a new position is opened.
